outcome: microbial profile of lacrimal sac resurge
cohort: 71 eyes of 52 pediatric patients (<5 years old) with CNLDO
finding: CNLDO was more commonly unilateral, in male, preterm, and normal birth weight infants, while bilateral CNLDO was more commonly associated with coexisting ocular or systemic anomalies.
mod_finding: Prematurity, delivery by Caesarean section, and presence of congenital anomalies were associated with a prolonged course.
